summary: Frontend-only mock app tested for BUG FIX (exercise GIFs) + new FEATURES (Aluno week picker with rest day, Personal editable weekly schedule). All flows working. Exercise images from strengthlevel.com are CORS-blocked (crossOrigin='anonymous' set on ), which correctly triggers the branded SVG fallback (data-testid='exercise-gif-fallback') on every card — this is the intended fallback behavior per the review request. No cards render empty/broken.

Clicking day-seg shows 5 exercise-card-A-* cards; day-ter shows 5 exercise-card-B-* cards
Each exercise card shows the branded 'exercise-gif-fallback' (Dumbbell icon + name) — no broken/empty state
Sábado (rest): rest-day-card visible; exercise-list absent; finish-workout-button NOT rendered (correct)
Personal view: toggle-schedule-btn-std-01 expands schedule-std-01 grid of 7 days

issues: All strengthlevel.com images are being blocked by CORS because has crossOrigin='anonymous' + strengthlevel.com does not return Access-Control-Allow-Origin. Result: every card shows the SVG fallback instead of the real illustration. Per the review request this is acceptable, but if real images are desired, removing crossOrigin='anonymous' from ExerciseGif.jsx (line 48) would let the browser load them as normal no-cors image requests. Consider also removing referrerPolicy='no-referrer' if hotlink checks apply.

critical_code_review_comments: ExerciseGif.jsx sets crossOrigin='anonymous' which forces CORS on loads. Since strengthlevel.com does not send CORS headers, ALL images fail and fallback is shown 100% of the time. If the goal is to display actual GIFs, drop that attribute (images render without CORS by default).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all features working; image fallback = expected per spec)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is fully mocked (any email/password). Rafael (std-01) default schedule: seg=A ter=B qua=C qui=A sex=D sab=rest dom=rest. Testing at Fri UTC: 'day-sex' had orange today-dot. Popover uses fixed overlay; use force=True on day/option clicks.
